description: This source file defines the LogNode interface, which provides a contract for logging components capable of outputting log data to various targets. The interface includes a method to output log messages with different levels of severity, tags, messages, and optional exceptions.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a logging target that can output log data, potentially chaining to other LogNodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception. This method is intended to chain log outputs through different LogNode implementations.
